description: This file defines a utility class called Proxifier that facilitates creating proxy instances of objects by wrapping them with specified wrapper classes implementing additional behavior.

classes.name: Proxifier
classes.description: A utility class for creating proxy instances of objects with specified wrappers.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy of the given object t, wrapped with an instance of the specified Wrapper subclass.

methods.name: instantiate
methods.description: Instantiates a Wrapper subclass that wraps the object t by invoking its constructor with t.
